# Olaf Dsouza

> Personal site and engineering blog for Olaf Dsouza, a software engineer focused on operating systems, LLMs, and distributed systems.

Olaf is a software engineer at Netflix and a University of Michigan CS/CSE alum who has also worked at August Law and Quail AI. This site hosts his portfolio, experience, blog, and ranked food guides.

Profiles: [GitHub](https://github.com/o1af), [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/olafdsouza), [Google Maps reviews](https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106624836567647814704).

## Primary Pages
- [Home](https://olafdsouza.com/): Portfolio, experience, and project overview.
- [Blog](https://olafdsouza.com/blog): Writing on operating systems, LLMs, distributed systems, and CS coursework.
- [Food](https://olafdsouza.com/food): Ranked guides to the 741 restaurants, coffee shops, bakeries and bars Olaf has rated, 387 with written notes.
- [How I rate](https://olafdsouza.com/food/how-i-rate): How the food scores work: opportunity cost, mixing taste, price and value with a little atmosphere.
- [Connections](https://olafdsouza.com/connections): NYT Connections tracking board.

## Blog Posts
- [Your inference provider sucks (at caching)](https://olafdsouza.com/blog/your-inference-provider-sucks-at-caching): The same agent session cost $0.13 on one DeepSeek V4 Flash provider and $2.30 on another. Prompt cache hit rate, not list price, explains the 17.7× gap.
- [The Area Over the Curve](https://olafdsouza.com/blog/the-area-over-the-curve): Why the cheapest LLM is rarely the cheapest result, and how August routes each agent task to just enough model intelligence.
- [Everything is a Workflow](https://olafdsouza.com/blog/everything-is-a-workflow): How workflows became August's abstraction for reliable legal AI agents, growing from saved prompts into a small programming language.
- [HOPS](https://olafdsouza.com/blog/hops-pipeline-simulator): A discrete-event simulator for pipeline-parallel LLM training on heterogeneous GPUs, validated within 2% of real hardware.
- [Frame Classification in Congressional Speeches with NLP](https://olafdsouza.com/blog/nlp-project): Using NLP to classify rhetorical framing in U.S. Congressional speeches, our University of Michigan CSE 595 final project.
- [An Honest Review of Every ULCS Class I Have Taken at Michigan](https://olafdsouza.com/blog/ulcs-class-reviews-michigan): Honest reviews and ratings for every upper-level CS (ULCS) class at the University of Michigan.

## Food Guides
### New York
- [Best restaurants in New York](https://olafdsouza.com/food/new-york/restaurants): Every restaurant I've rated in New York, ranked by score. Top picks: Angel (10.0), Mama's TOO! Pizzeria West Village (10.0), Adda (9.9).
- [Best coffee in New York](https://olafdsouza.com/food/new-york/coffee): Every coffee, tea and boba spot I've rated in New York, ranked by score. Top picks: Toby's Estate Coffee (9.9), Caffe Paradiso (9.9), HEYTEA（Herald Square） (9.8).
- [Best dessert in New York](https://olafdsouza.com/food/new-york/dessert): Every dessert spot I've rated in New York, ranked by score. Top picks: Caffè Panna (10.0), Spot Dessert Bar East Village (9.9), common meadows creamery (9.8).
- [Best bakeries in New York](https://olafdsouza.com/food/new-york/bakeries): Every bakery I've rated in New York, ranked by score. Top picks: L'Appartement 4F (9.8), Radio Bakery (9.6), Mei Lai Wah (9.5).
- [Best restaurants in the East Village](https://olafdsouza.com/food/new-york/east-village-restaurants): Every restaurant I've rated in the East Village, New York, ranked by score. Adda for the curry and a surprisingly great dessert, Soothr and Cello's Pizzeria right behind it, and Farook Halal Food for rice and meat at $8.
- [Best restaurants in the Flatiron District](https://olafdsouza.com/food/new-york/flatiron-district-restaurants): Every restaurant I've rated in the Flatiron District, New York, ranked by score. Top picks: Counter Service (9.2), Just Salad (8.6), INDAY (8.5).
- [Best coffee in the East Village](https://olafdsouza.com/food/new-york/east-village-coffee): Every coffee, tea and boba spot I've rated in the East Village, New York, ranked by score. Top picks: Square Coffee (9.6), Hidden Grounds Chai & Coffee House - Manhattan (9.2), hani’s bakery + café (9.0).

### Ann Arbor
- [Best restaurants in Ann Arbor](https://olafdsouza.com/food/ann-arbor/restaurants): Every restaurant I've rated in Ann Arbor, ranked by score. Frita Batidos Ann Arbor is my favorite, Miny's Mexican Restaurant is easily the best Mexican in town (get the churros and the shrimp taco), and The Jefferson Market has maybe the best scrambled eggs I've ever had.
- [Best coffee in Ann Arbor](https://olafdsouza.com/food/ann-arbor/coffee): Every coffee, tea and boba spot I've rated in Ann Arbor, ranked by score. Hyperion Coffee Co for the best beans in town, The Boro Cafe & Bakery for the coffee (skip the $10 crookie), and Cahoots Cafe, which brews Hyperion beans better than Hyperion does.
- [Best dessert in Ann Arbor](https://olafdsouza.com/food/ann-arbor/dessert): Every dessert spot I've rated in Ann Arbor, ranked by score. La Dolce Vita Ann Arbor for gelato (vanilla over caramel), then Milk & Froth Ice Cream and Blank Slate Creamery.
- [Best bars in Ann Arbor](https://olafdsouza.com/food/ann-arbor/bars): Every bar I've rated in Ann Arbor, ranked by score. Top picks: Bill's Beer Garden (10.0), Babs' Underground (9.7), Bløm Mead + Cider (8.9).
- [Best restaurants in the Old West Side](https://olafdsouza.com/food/ann-arbor/old-west-side-restaurants): Every restaurant I've rated in the Old West Side, Ann Arbor, ranked by score. Top picks: Frita Batidos Ann Arbor (9.8), The Jefferson Market (9.4), Eat Thai Ann Arbor (9.0).
- [Best restaurants in Burns Park](https://olafdsouza.com/food/ann-arbor/burns-park-restaurants): Every restaurant I've rated in Burns Park, Ann Arbor, ranked by score. Top picks: Jamaican Jerk Pit (9.2), No Thai! South U (8.6), Taste of India Suvai (8.4).
- [Best coffee in Burns Park](https://olafdsouza.com/food/ann-arbor/burns-park-coffee): Every coffee, tea and boba spot I've rated in Burns Park, Ann Arbor, ranked by score. Top picks: Bearclaw Coffee Co. (7.8), Argus Farm Stop - Packard Cafe (7.5), UMMA Cafe (7.3).

### South Bay
- [Best restaurants in the South Bay](https://olafdsouza.com/food/south-bay/restaurants): Every restaurant I've rated in the South Bay, ranked by score. Top picks: Tacos Mi Reynita (9.9), Bloom Bagels (9.9), Mazala Pizza San Jose (9.9).
- [Best coffee in the South Bay](https://olafdsouza.com/food/south-bay/coffee): Every coffee, tea and boba spot I've rated in the South Bay, ranked by score. Top picks: Dr.ink (10.0), Cowboy Coffee (9.8), PRIMERO CAFECITO (9.8).
- [Best dessert in the South Bay](https://olafdsouza.com/food/south-bay/dessert): Every dessert spot I've rated in the South Bay, ranked by score. Top picks: Na Ya Dessert Cafe (9.8), Easy Breezy Frozen Yogurt Los Gatos (9.6), Pints of Joy (9.5).
- [Best restaurants in San Jose](https://olafdsouza.com/food/south-bay/san-jose-restaurants): Every restaurant I've rated in San Jose, ranked by score. Top picks: Tacos Mi Reynita (9.9), Mazala Pizza San Jose (9.9), Mylapore South Indian Vegetarian (9.9).
- [Best coffee in San Jose](https://olafdsouza.com/food/south-bay/san-jose-coffee): Every coffee, tea and boba spot I've rated in San Jose, ranked by score. Top picks: Dr.ink (10.0), PRIMERO CAFECITO (9.8), Chromatic Coffee Co. (9.7).
- [Best dessert in San Jose](https://olafdsouza.com/food/south-bay/san-jose-dessert): Every dessert spot I've rated in San Jose, ranked by score. Top picks: Na Ya Dessert Cafe (9.8), Churros La Guadalupana (8.3), Fosters Freeze (8.3).

### Metro Detroit
- [Best restaurants in Metro Detroit](https://olafdsouza.com/food/metro-detroit/restaurants): Every restaurant I've rated in Metro Detroit, ranked by score. Top picks: QUE PASA TAQUERIA (9.9), Hyderabad house Indian Restaurant & Bakery (9.5), Phở Lucky (9.2).
- [Best coffee in Metro Detroit](https://olafdsouza.com/food/metro-detroit/coffee): Every coffee, tea and boba spot I've rated in Metro Detroit, ranked by score. Top picks: Jabal Coffee House (9.3), Apothecary Espresso and Coffee (9.2), Tous Les Jours Novi (8.9).
- [Best dessert in Metro Detroit](https://olafdsouza.com/food/metro-detroit/dessert): Every dessert spot I've rated in Metro Detroit, ranked by score. Top picks: Custard Time (9.5), JJ's Custard Co. (9.2), FROZONE - House of Gelato (8.0).
- [Best restaurants in Novi](https://olafdsouza.com/food/metro-detroit/novi-restaurants): Every restaurant I've rated in Novi, ranked by score. Hyderabad house Indian Restaurant & Bakery is my top pick, Phở Lucky for pho and Mala Land for a good spice level. At Shiro Restaurant, stick to the sushi rolls.
- [Best restaurants in Northville](https://olafdsouza.com/food/metro-detroit/northville-restaurants): Every restaurant I've rated in Northville, ranked by score. Top picks: Brava Empanadas (8.5), Thai Fresh (8.1), Browndog Barlor & Restaurant (7.4).
